answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in sparrow, expire in island, and ledge lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 162 aliases therefore needs 125 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 12 dollars in locked collateral and another 10 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
